text:
elaine (pm): Quick thread: drafting a Q3 "policy strata" plan for multi-region + tenant isolation pilots. Need to pick pilots and final launch gates by Wed.

samir (arch): Proposal: three policy strata - soft-affinity (best-effort), strict-affinity (route pinned, fallback disabled), and hybrid (route-level pin + degraded-model fallback). Each changes placement, caching, and telemetry needs.

miguel (eng): Tech note: strict-affinity -> node labeling / reserved pools; expects higher reserved GPU overhead and worse bin-packing. I'll model 3-customer sizing delta once pilots chosen.

nina (sre): Ops checklist for any pilot: canary 5-10%, stability window 20m, p95 <= 2x baseline, alert on fallback rate >1/min. Add synthetic probes per-region to assert served-region.

hara (cs): Customers (FinCo, Acme) want route-scoped residency + audit trail of routing decisions. We need a plain-language policy summary for contracts and a comms template that lists covered routes and failover behavior.

samir (arch): DSL sketch to help product/legal reason about permutations:
```
policy {
  id: "finco_payments"
  match: {customer: "FinCo", route: "payments"}
  isolation: "strict"
  regions: ["eu-west-1"]
  fallback: {allowed: false}
}
```
miguel (eng): Also include defaults for autoscale in policy: min_reserved_gpus, max_burst, eviction_window. If product doesn't pick we'll use conservative defaults (costly).

elaine (pm): Launch gates (draft): 1) 99.5% regional success over 24h canary, 2) pilot cost cap acknowledged, 3) in-region KMS for residency, 4) legal + CS summary approved. Actions: product owners add pilot rows to matrix by Mon EOD; eng sizing (miguel) Tue; SRE runbook + probes (nina) Tue; arch telemetry spec (samir) Tue. We'll lock pilots Wed.

ops-bot: policy-telemetry deployment queued to staging.

elaine (pm): Thanks all — keep comments limited to blockers. We'll aim to select FinCo + BetaLabs as candidates (one revenue, one low-risk) unless objections.
